name: Nrem
detailed_description:
About the Game

Nrem is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle platformer, built around a unique, reflection mechanic that lets you traverse environments in creative and unexpected ways.

You play as The Watcher – named Lou – a quiet observer in a dreamlike world where memories shape reality. After breaking the sacred rule of non-intervention, Lou steals a fragment of a mirror connected to a struggling human. That single act of compassion sets off a ripple effect across the mystical Nrem World, a realm where dreams are forged and guided by strange and enchanting beings.

Features

  • Reflection-Based Traversal
    Wield the Mirror Ability to project and reflect yourself across surfaces using Reflective Nodes as anchors. Shift position, bypass obstacles, and chain together reflections to solve spatial puzzles in ways that defy conventional platforming.

  • Intuitive Player Controls
    Responsive movement and jumping are seamlessly integrated with the Mirror Ability, allowing for fluid transitions between physical and reflected states. Mastery comes from understanding rhythm, positioning, and perspective.

  • Atmospheric Puzzle Design
    Explore handcrafted levels with traversal and logic challenges that evolve alongside the Mirror Ability. Puzzles are layered, rewarding exploration, experimentation, and creative problem-solving.

  • Narrative-Driven Exploration
    Experience a subtle, emotionally resonant narrative told through the world itself. Lou’s journey explores themes of empathy, memory, and the consequences of intervention.

  • Stylized Visuals & Sound
    A distinct visual identity paired with an ambient, original soundtrack creates a reflective and immersive experience that complements the game’s dreamlike tone.

  • Single-Player Experience
    Designed for solo players seeking immersive, thoughtful gameplay—no combat, no dialogue trees—just mechanics, mood, and meaning.

Nrem is designed for players who enjoy reflective, story-rich puzzle games that emphasize atmosphere, emotional depth, and thoughtful traversal over fast-paced action.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
